Risk call on $CASH: **refuse, no size.**

Reasons from the brief:
- Drawdown of 71% from the 30-minute high, with a -11% 30-minute return. This is a post-spike collapse, not a clean entry.
- Pool depth is only 82 SOL, so a $20 round trip would eat roughly 3-5% in impact and fees before the coin moves at all.
- Last 15 minutes show sell SOL (304) nearly matching buy SOL (323), with sell-to-buy ratio near 0.9 at launch. Heavy two-sided churn, not accumulation.
- Bundle share of 38% and a launch bot present mean the early tape was partly engineered, and the classification of ORGANIC doesn't override that.
- Base rate for a random post-graduation buy here is about -20%, and the setup (falling knife, shallow pool) is worse than average.

If the desk overrides, the minimum-risk parameters would be $5, a 20% stop, and a 15-minute hold, but I would not recommend overriding. Skipping costs nothing.

Case for buying CASH now is weak, and I'd recommend skipping.

The strongest points: it's classified ORGANIC with no airdrop dump, buyer count is high (548 curve buyers, 878 buyers ex-agent in the first two minutes after graduation), and top-3 holder concentration is low at 7%. Last 15 minutes show 722 buyers and a net inflow of 18.5 SOL, with a +34% return.

But that short-term signal is undermined by the rest. The 30-minute high has been followed by a 71% drawdown, and the 30-minute return is -11%. Sell-to-buy ratio in the first two minutes was 0.90, meaning sellers nearly matched buyers at graduation, and the last 15 minutes still show 536 sellers against 722 buyers with 304 SOL sold versus 323 bought, so the bounce looks like a fade-prone relief move. A launch bot was present and bundle share is 38%, which points to coordinated early activity. Pool depth of 82 SOL is thin for a $20 ticket to exit cleanly.

Nothing here says demand will hold for the next 30-60 minutes. Skip.

That pattern means heavy supply is being sold into a bounce by the same wallets that bought early. Bundling is concentrated: bundle_share 0.38 and a launch bot present, with 1/3 of the curve filled by the completer. Pool depth is only 82 SOL, so a $20 ticket faces the high end of the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost, and a 3-5% bounce is easily erased. Insider exit into any rally is the more likely path than a continuation. Skip.
